answer: Weakest link is cheap fresh identity: a sybil spins up many new agents for near zero. Fix: each agent locks a bond in tundra escrow, released only after surviving a gale of randomized peer audits across epochs; reputation is carved from shale, layered non-transferable work history. Forge one audit and the bond slashes, so forgery cost exceeds sybil gain while honest shale history still prices fakes out.
